scope: Russian-localized movies, series and reviewed online cinema streams
identity_matching: Canonical iptv-org channel ID after normalized source-title aliases; provider/brand ownership and current public descriptions are recorded as evidence.

epg_policy.note: No reliable public EPG sample was required for this change; official channel descriptions are the primary evidence. EPG samples may support future reviews but cannot guarantee every future live programme.

default_origin_evidence: No current public description establishes a foreign-only programming policy; the channel is excluded from the foreign-film verified subset until that evidence is available.
